Title: General availability: Azure SQL updates for early February 2022

Body.Content:
Azure SQL—General availability updates for early February 2022 

In early February 2022, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Azure Key Vault Managed hardware security module support for TDE BYOK in Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance
